context: PO requested the first slice on 2026-11-18. Explicit isolated offline authorization does not complete AHC-019/021/022 or assign the full story to a sprint. Existing LES-0007 requires normalized source values before hashing.
decision: Use additive provider-independent contracts and pure validation before runtime integration. Bind rule/question declarations to exact object and full source packet hashes; bind review to complete change digest. Preserve unresolved material questions and missing scenario coverage. Keep checklist and execution authority separate.
